name: @fairwins/assistant-contract
description: The single definition of the FairWins assistant's system prompt, tool table and honest result wording (spec 104). Zero runtime dependencies; resolvable by plain Node and by Vite. Consumed by the relay gateway (FairWins rail), the frontend (both rails) and, as a vendored snapshot gated by a parity test, the dependency-free MCP server.
